title: The Long And Winding Road
lyrics_synced:
[00:02.68] The long and winding road
[00:07.14] that leads to your door,
[00:15.00] Will never disappear,
[00:20.54] I've seen that road before
[00:26.43] It always leads me here,
[00:32.32] leads me to your door.
[00:36.96] The wild and windy night
[00:41.79] the rain washed away,
[00:49.82] Has left a pool of tears
[00:55.18] crying for the day.
[01:00.71] Why leave me standing here,
[01:06.61] let me know the way
[01:11.43] Many times I've been alone
[01:14.11] and many times I've cried
[01:17.14] Anyway you'll never know
[01:19.82] the many ways I've tried,
[01:22.68] But still they lead me back
[01:27.14] to the long and winding road
[01:35.00] You left me standing here
[01:40.89] a long, long time ago
[01:46.43] Don't leave me waiting here,
[01:52.50] lead me to your door
[02:08.39] The long and winding road
[02:12.86] that leads to your door,
[02:20.71] You left me standing here
[02:26.61] a long, long time ago
[02:32.14] Don't leave me waiting here,
[02:37.86] lead me to your door
